title: Palmyra Atoll National Wildlife Refuge
summary: Palmyra Atoll, along with Kingman Reef, are remnants of volcanoes from 65-120 million years ago. Palmyra Atoll is located approximately 956 nautical miles south of Honolulu, about halfway between Hawaiʻi and America Samoa, and consists of a circular string of about 26 islets nestled among several lagoons and encircled by 15,000 acres of shallow turquoise reefs and deep blue submerged reefs.
